{{Short description|Dutch mycologist (1928–2013)}}
'''Dr. Cornelis (Kees) Bas''' (1928 &ndash; February 10, 2013) was a [[Dutch people|Dutch]] [[mycologist]].

Dr. Bas was born in [[Rotterdam]] and graduated in [[Biology]] at [[Leiden University]] in 1954. In 1953, he began working at the National Herbarium of the [[Netherlands]], as curator for the [[fungi]], in particular, the [[Agaricales]]. Early in his career he played an important role in modernizing the collections of Dutch and [[Europe|European]] higher fungi.<ref name="Persoonia">{{cite web|url=https://www.persoonia.org/Issue/21/00.pdf |archive-url=https://archive.today/20121128171321/http://www.persoonia.org/Issue/21/00.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-date=2012-11-28 |title=Dedication to Dr Cornelis Bas |year=2008 |publisher=Persoonia |accessdate=2009-04-08 }}</ref> He died on February 10, 2013.<ref name="Death">{{cite journal|title = Kees Bas overleden|journal = Paddenstoelennieuwsbrief|issue = 1|page = 1|publisher = [[Netherlands Mycological Society]]|date = 2013-03-06|language = Dutch|url = http://www.allesoverpaddenstoelen.nl/nieuwsbrief/pdf/Paddenstoelennieuwsbrief_001_6-3-2013.pdf|accessdate = 2013-07-25}}</ref>
